title: Art. 6.16 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 6 - International Airports - Facilities and Services for Traffic, B. Airport traffic flow arrangements, III. Outbound passengers, crew and baggage, 6.16
content: Recommended Practice. Each Contracting State should allow airport and aircraft operators to provide off- airport check- in facilities, so long as all necessary security measures and other control requirements are met.
